description: One call for one company domain: site identity, tech stack, email security, hosting, DNS and registration age, plus an OFAC name screen. Use when an agent must vet a counterparty before dealing with it: a deterministic answer with a signed receipt and per-section failures. Public sources only; no private data. Example: domain=stripe.com. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
